lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance pixel clusters are arranged in a multi-row grid posterior to the gill region. The spots form a 2D matrix with roughly equidistant spacing between local maxima in both horizontal and vertical axes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs. These spots are positioned as anchor nodes at the intersection of the vertical and horizontal structural axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear features are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadowed pixels below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible area of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, with approximately 6 distinct spots visible within its silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct low-luminance circular mark is visible on the posterior upper surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the surrounding high-intensity spot pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp transition in spot morphology is observed between the cranial and lateral regions; the cranial area features dense, small, irregular punctate marks while the flank features larger, structured circular blobs.
